rationales: A see-saw does not rotate continuously in one direction.
Its motion is not along a circular path.
A see-saw moves to and fro about a position, so it is vibratory motion.
Its motion is regular, not random.
The resultant of all forces acting on a body is its net force.
Friction is only one possible force acting on a body.
Gravity is only one possible force acting on a body.
Force is the general term; the resultant is specifically called net force.
Inertia depends on a body's mass.
Force can change motion but does not measure inertia.
Weight is the gravitational force on a body, not its inertia.
Energy is not the measure of inertia.
The value of sin 30° is not 0.15.
0.866 is approximately sin 60°, not sin 30°.
0.707 is approximately sin 45°, not sin 30°.
sin 30° equals 0.5.
10 m s⁻² is approximately the value of g on Earth, not the Moon.
The Moon's gravitational acceleration is approximately 1.62 m s⁻².
3.7 m s⁻² is approximately the value of g on Mars.
3.9 m s⁻² is not the accepted value of g on the Moon.
Energy is the capacity to do work, not the rate of doing it.
Torque is the turning effect of a force.
Force is not the rate of doing work.
Power is the rate of doing work.
Newton's laws are not the principle on which a hydraulic press operates.
A hydraulic press works according to Pascal's law.
Archimedes' principle describes buoyancy, not the operation of a hydraulic press.
Hooke's law describes the relationship between force and extension in an elastic material.
The watt is a unit of power.
The kelvin is a unit of temperature.
The joule is the SI unit of heat energy.
The ampere is a unit of electric current.
273 °C is not absolute zero.
373 °C is not absolute zero.
Absolute zero is approximately −273 °C.
0 °C is the freezing point of water, not absolute zero.
A measuring cylinder is not used to measure mass.
A measuring cylinder does not measure area.
A measuring cylinder is used to measure the volume of a liquid.
It can show a liquid's level, but its purpose is to measure volume.
A pendulum does not travel along a straight line.
A clock pendulum swings to and fro, so its motion is vibratory.
The pendulum does not rotate continuously about an axis.
A clock pendulum's motion is regular, not random.
P = ma is Newton's second law, not the formula for momentum.
P = dt is not the formula for momentum.
P = F×d does not give momentum.
Momentum is mass multiplied by velocity: P = mv.
Centripetal force acts toward the centre and keeps a body moving in a circle.
Magnetic force can cause circular motion in some situations but is not the general force required.
Gravitational force can provide centripetal force in orbital motion but is not the general answer.
Centrifugal force is an apparent outward force in a rotating frame, not the inward force that maintains circular motion.
10000 kg m⁻³ is ten times the approximate density of water.
The density of water is approximately 1000 kg m⁻³.
100 kg m⁻³ is too low for water.
10 kg m⁻³ is far too low for water.
Torque has SI unit newton metre (N·m).
The newton is a unit of force, not torque.
N m⁻² is a unit of pressure.
N m⁻¹ is not the SI unit of torque.
